key_reasoning.reason: New abstractions across one service: ProvisioningClientsConfig registry, provisioning_access (scope lock, provisioning_clients_only guard, RequirePermission), provisioning router package and ProvisioningService, plus edits to authenticate(), user_type_validator, authentication_service, personal_project_service and main.py, and removal of the ServiceNow router, access module and settings. Base L, bumped for touching the core authenticate() path.

Authorization-sensitive: every registered client is confined to the provisioning router's (method, path) allowlist from inside authenticate(), with per-route permissions and fail-fast startup on a bad registry. The closest precedent, the ServiceNow-only service-account check, was replaced rather than reused, so there is no exact pattern. Base L, bumped for affecting auth/authz.

33 files in the diffstat (1473+/1588-) across config/, src/codemie/{configs,rest_api,service} and tests/, which maps to XXL. The count is inflated by mirrored test files, the regenerated OpenAPI baseline and the ServiceNow deletions; the new production code is about 6 files.

Agrees with the bundled L example epmcdme-10401 (22: registry + config + multi-layer). Differs from the bundled XL example epmcdme-10303 (27), which adds a heavyweight dependency and a cross-system integration. This change has neither: no new packages, and the repositories are reused unchanged.

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk bumped from L to XL: affects authentication and authorization (scope lock enforced in authenticate(), per-route RequirePermission)
Component Scope bumped from L to XL: touches core shared utilities (authenticate() and is_service_account/user_type_validator, used by the auth and personal-project services)
